question: Related Questions Q. I am elder son me and my father start doing business by investing equal amount of money,after one year second son also start helping in the business. After seven year father me want to seprat our business due to some dispute. Now pls guide us according shariah how shell we divide our money and property (either purchased or cunstructed) in these years? 1568 views Q. Currently there is a difference of opinion regarding what is known as ?Islamic Banking.? There are some ulama that are of the opinion that this type of banking and the services that they provide are halaal and a practicing Muslim should have not fear and fully take advantage of the variety of services being offered by these same banks. On the other hand there are a group of scholars that aver that this type of banking is no different than regular commercial non Islamic banks. The only differences being in the terminology, but the actual transactions fall into the category of riba. Our question to the ulama ikram is: in the opinion of your darul iftaa, which group is correct, as both can not be correct in this case. Please explain your fatwa completely which will eliminate the doubts in the minds of the common people. 2588 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 12970 Country: India Title: asl, iam commission agent.my work is to sale the machines and get the commission from two side,(purchare & saler) in that soft work. no hard work only to introduce both party.i will ask money with my expectation not parties offer,whether this is halal income or haram. Question: asl, iam commission agent.my work is to sale the machines and get the commission from two side,(purchare & saler) in that soft work. no hard work only to introduce both party.i will ask money with my expectation not parties offer,whether this is halal income or haram. Answer ID: 12970 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 975/827=D/1430) It is lawful to receive the charge agreed mutually, provided you have dealing with both the parties to take the charge of introducing them with each other and no deception and cheating is involved therein. Such income will be halal and lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
